clan.name: Below Zero
clan.description: Welcome to the point of freezing. We are recruiting! We are a guild focused on growing our members from Colonial Age through to the Space Ages. To do this, we prioritize GE and GBG.We provide: - 1.9 and Break Even (full Arc bonus) threads to grow your GBs - Guild level giving 11 FP a day and Alcatraz collection under 16 hours - Support from very experienced players - Fun and competitive environment - Active Discord community We expect:  - GE 32 every week and over 48 when needed - Participation in each GBG season - Arc lvl 80, Observatory lvl 60 (or working towards both) - Donations to treasury if needed for GBG etc - GVG support if interested (PC players)We work in partnership with our sister guild Lords of War, so you can expect guidance and help from members of both BZ and LOW on our shared Discord channel.Apply by messaging any founder or leader. We look forward to hearing from you!If you’re interested, but do not quite meet the requirements yet, please message us to discuss options.
